FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS build
WORKDIR /app
RUN corepack enable
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN npm --prefix server ci
RUN cd server && npx --no-install prisma generate
RUN VITE_API_URL=/api pnpm run build
RUN node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); let s=fs.readFileSync("server/prisma/seed.ts","utf8"); s=s.slice(0,s.indexOf("  const adminHash")); s += "  const username = \"sindiswa-cell\";\n  if (!(await prisma.admin.findUnique({where:{username}}))) await prisma.admin.create({data:{username,fullName:username,email:username+\"@owner.invalid\",passwordHash:await bcrypt.hash(process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD,12),active:true,mustChangePassword:false}});\n}\nmain().finally(()=>prisma.$disconnect()).catch(()=>{console.error(\"Initialization failed\");process.exit(1)});\n"; fs.writeFileSync("server/initialize.mjs",s);'
RUN printf '%s\n' 'import express from "express";' 'import http from "node:http";' 'import {spawn,execFileSync} from "node:child_process";' 'import fs from "node:fs";' 'if (!process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD || !process.env.JWT_SECRET) throw new Error("Required runtime secrets missing");' 'fs.mkdirSync("/app/.data/uploads",{recursive:true});' 'execFileSync("node",["node_modules/prisma/build/index.js","db","push","--schema","prisma/schema.prisma","--skip-generate"],{stdio:"inherit"});' 'execFileSync("node",["initialize.mjs"],{stdio:"inherit"});' 'const child=spawn("node",["--import","tsx","src/index.ts"],{stdio:"inherit",env:{...process.env,PORT:"4000"}});' 'child.on("exit",code=>process.exit(code || 1));' 'const app=express();' 'app.use((req,res,next)=>{if(!req.url.startsWith("/api/") && !req.url.startsWith("/uploads/")) return next(); const upstream=http.request({hostname:"127.0.0.1",port:4000,path:req.url,method:req.method,headers:req.headers},r=>{res.writeHead(r.statusCode,r.headers);r.pipe(res)}); upstream.on("error",()=>res.sendStatus(503)); req.pipe(upstream);});' 'app.use(express.static("/app/dist"));' 'app.get("/{*path}",(_req,res)=>res.sendFile("/app/dist/index.html"));' 'const server=app.listen(8080,"0.0.0.0");' 'for(const signal of ["SIGTERM","SIGINT"]) process.on(signal,()=>{server.close();child.kill(signal);});' > server/start.mjs
FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8
WORKDIR /app/server
ENV NODE_ENV=production DATABASE_URL=file:/app/.data/application.sqlite HOME=/tmp TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1
COPY --from=build /app/server /app/server
COPY --from=build /app/dist /app/dist
RUN rm -rf /app/server/uploads && ln -s /app/.data/uploads /app/server/uploads && mkdir -p /app/.data && chown 10001:10001 /app/.data
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["node","start.mjs"]
